## Is your request related to a problem

A clear description of the limitation or gap you ran into.

## Describe the solution you would like

What you want the addon to do that it does not do today.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Anything else that would help, such as a sketch or reference dimensions.
